description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing long-term support, new language features, performance improvements, and security updates.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Ensure build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) targets Java 25. Update any Java version references in CI/CD pipelines, Dockerfiles, or toolchain configurations. Verify that all dependencies are compatible with Java 25.
